title: Anthropic's Claude Goes After Legal Work
caption: Anthropic just made Claude fluent in legal language. Not assistive—competitive. Law firms are watching. Here's what changed and why it matters for knowledge work everywhere.

slides.headline: Claude just became a legal expert

slides.body: Anthropic trained Claude specifically on legal documents, case law, and contract language. It's not replacing paralegals anymore—it's competing with junior associates.

slides.title: Contract review in minutes
slides.body: Claude now identifies non-standard clauses, flags risk language, and suggests redlines. What took 3 hours of billable time now takes 8 minutes. Law firms are testing it on real M&A deals.

slides.title: Case law research that cites itself
slides.body: The new update pulls precedent from 50 years of case law and formats citations correctly. It doesn't hallucinate dockets. Verified accuracy rate sits at 94% according to Anthropic's internal tests.
